ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/off-white pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the trailing edge, notch vertex, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A vast, contiguous high-intensity region occupies the central lobes; low-intensity pigmentation forms a thin border along the trailing edge and a wider, irregular mask around the median notch; sparse dark mottling (pixel clusters) is visible on the inner-left and lower-right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 25% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixels); notable macro-irregularity and high-relief protrusions at the right distal tip due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a primary convex trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips, with the tips exhibiting a slight upward/outward sweep (recurvature) relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark-toned circular clusters (3-7 pixels diameter) are sparsely distributed across the medial white surface; high-intensity, high-relief three-dimensional pixel clusters (barnacles) are concentrated at the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, sub-horizontal dark linear pixel disruptions are detectable on the mid-left lobe, cutting through the high-intensity background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial anatomical irregularity and structural encrustation localized at the right fluke tip; multiple small jagged indentations along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric pigmentation pattern at the median notch vertex, where the dark pixel region extends deeper into the left lobe than the right.
